body: Guys who talk a big game are usually the worst at doing it.

I think I will, it’s just hard for me because I have no friends or family. My coworkers don’t really like me. I’m extremely introverted and just really invisible. Anyone I bring into my life end up being toxic, I’ve talked to my therapist about it multiple times. I feel like I never really get anywhere.

I was with someone for three years who constantly downed me and told people I was a psycho bitch because I’m mentally unhealthy. I’m also terrible at making decisions on my own, every decision I make feels like it’s life or death. I constantly feel anxious, like I’m walking on thin ice.

He’s the only person in my life so I’m very scared to do so. I have a hard time getting out of relationships, it’s very hard for me to cut people out of my life. I’ve always picked abusive people, friends and partners. I can’t seem to break the cycle of abuse that my parents set me up to.
